text:
Diego R: Hey — first day and running into a few provisioning problems. I clicked the Google invite but Okta signup says "multiple accounts found" and asks me to pick an account. I only have my corporate samename@redwoodinference.com + a personal gmail that I used earlier. Also 1Password says "no seat available" when I try to join the company vault. Who do I poke?

IT Support: Welcome Diego! For the Okta multiple-accounts flow, try the explicit Okta invite link (not the generic 'Sign in with Google' flow) — paste it here if you can. Also confirm the corporate email on your badge. For 1Password seat issues I'll check licensing; sometimes we hit a temporary seat cap after a bulk hire.

Diego R: Invite link: https://accounts.redwoodinference.com/invite/ghijk. Badge email is diego.r@redwoodinference.com. I did the Google sign-in in Chrome where I'm logged into my personal account, might be picking the wrong session.

IT Support: Ok, send me that link in a DM in case the invite is sensitive. Quick troubleshooting: open incognito or use the explicit Okta link with the query param `?sp=okta` — that bypasses the Google account chooser. If the multiple account chooser persists, we can merge the external acct.

license-bot: Notified People Ops: license_request/2532112345 for 1Password seat for diego.r@redwoodinference.com.

Marta (People Ops): Looks like the 1Password pool is temporarily at max due to last week's contractor batch. I can free a seat by migrating one contractor to temp access. Will do and ping back in ~5 mins.

okta-bot: Created ticket OKTA-7821 for account merge check for diego.r@redwoodinference.com; assigned to IT Support.

IT Support: I checked directory — there's a legacy external account diego.r@gmail.com that has an existing GS profile. I'll merge the external alias into the corporate record and send a direct Okta invite. Also note: Android device-enroll sometimes doesn't send push if mobile push service is throttled. If you're on Android, use the QR-based enrollment flow in Okta Verify (Settings -> Add account -> Scan QR) or install via Play Store and follow the enroll link we send.

Diego R: I'm on Android. I tried the Play Store app first; it said "No push available for this account". Scanner would be fine.

IT Support: Sending new Okta invite now, includes QR. Also merged the external alias to the corporate user.

okta-bot: Sent Okta enrollment email to diego.r@redwoodinference.com with QR code link. Ticket OKTA-7821 updated.

Marta (People Ops): 1Password seat freed and invite sent. Check your personal email and corp email (sometimes it goes to one or the other).

Diego R: Got the Okta QR and scanned — phone enrollment completed. Google invite accepted. 1Password invite arrived in corp email, accepted, and I can see engineering vault now. Thanks everyone! :tada:

IT Support: Awesome. If you want the personal gmail removed from the directory mappings, tell us and we'll unlink it. Also file a ticket if you want SSH keys/Google Drive perms adjusted.

Diego R: Please unlink personal gmail, yes. And add me to eng-sre-drive group later. Thanks again :)
